title: A Warm Meal
description: Martha cooks for most of Elder Moor, and the stores are already thinner than she'd like this early in the season. She's not looking for help at the fire - she's looking for people who won't come to her hungry every time the meat's raw and the bread's out. Cook something yourself, and she'll worry about one less mouth.

objectives.description: Speak with Martha about why she's teaching a stranger
Cook some meat at the campfire

notes: Tutorial; no threat by design per spec. Giver motive supplied: Martha is stretched thin cooking for the camp with thin winter stores. No bible basis, local colour.
